headword: {自己肯定感|じここうていかん}

definitions.explanation: The feeling that one has value and worth as a person. A psychological concept that has become widely discussed in Japanese education, child-rearing, and self-help contexts.

examples.japanese: {自己肯定感|じここうていかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It's important to raise your self-esteem.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{自己肯定感|じここうていかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: If a child's self-esteem is low, it affects their school life too.

examples.japanese: ⟦{褒|ほ}められる→褒める：01204_homeru⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{自己肯定感|じここうていかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|はぐく}む→育む：10390_hagukumu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that experiences of being praised nurture self-esteem.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{自己|じこ}→自己：23357_jiko⟧ (self) + ⟦{肯定|こうてい}→肯定：04148_koutei⟧ (affirmation) + ⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧ (feeling). This term has become a buzzword in Japanese psychology, education, and parenting discussions. It is often discussed in the context of comparative studies showing that Japanese youth tend to report lower {自己肯定感|じここうていかん} than their peers in other countries.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自己肯定感|じここうていかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ (to have high self-esteem)
- {自己肯定感|じここうていかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧ (to have low self-esteem)
- {自己肯定感|じここうていかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧ (to raise self-esteem)
- {自己肯定感|じここうていかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|はぐく}む→育む：10390_hagukumu⟧ (to foster self-esteem)
